test_simple_bboxes_dense_head: test detection bounding boxes without augmentation using a DenseHead forward pass and get_results
test_aug_bboxes_dense_head: test detection bounding boxes with test-time augmentation including multiscale and flip augmentations
test_aug_rpn_proposals: test RPN proposals with augmentation by merging results from multiple augmented feature passes
merge_augmented_bboxes: merge augmented detection bboxes and scores by mapping back from flipped and scaled images
run_async_rpn_test: run an async RPN head forward pass with configurable sleep interval for non-blocking inference
